title: Shared deploy + auth SDK: true one-click install→activate across the catalog
notes: Today every tool reimplements install/auth; setup friction is the #1 churn driver between install and first deploy.

title: EchoVoice multi-language + accent expansion
notes: Most-loved tool; studios explicitly asking for non-English VO. Double-down on a proven winner.

title: BugHound GA + CI/CD integration (graduate from beta)
notes: Beta retention is top-tier; demand from studios on waitlist. Reach is estimated post-GA.

title: Storefront search & discovery revamp (filters, 'new', recommendations)
notes: Studios say they can't tell what's new or find the right tool; hurts reach for newer tools.

title: ArcaneArt reliability + performance overhaul
notes: Huge reach but breaks builds; ticket + infra sink. Fix-or-reframe decision.

title: Bespoke Hollow Crown lore fine-tune for Twin Hearth Studios
source: Twin Hearth Studios (top account, exec ask)
notes: Loudest single request, from the biggest studio. Huge value to ONE account, near-zero reuse.

title: Per-studio usage analytics dashboard
notes: Nice-to-have transparency; modest impact on adoption.

title: New tool: CutsceneDirector (AI cinematic gen)
notes: Exciting but unproven and expensive to build.
